name: Computer Motion
description: Computer Motion, Inc. was a medical robotics company founded in 1989 in Goleta (Santa Barbara), California, USA. The company developed the AESOP voice-controlled robotic endoscope positioner, the HERMES operating room control system, and the [Zeus](/robot/computer_motion_zeus) teleoperated surgical system before merging with [Intuitive](/company/intuitive) in 2003.

status.note: Merged with Intuitive Surgical in 2003, uniting Zeus and early da Vinci patent portfolios.
